purpose: Observe matched input/preparation/measurement/signed-value/decision paths after R81 and R84. No new method, oracle gain, semantic causality or L5 claim.

data.selected_split: Existing R72 evaluation partition; no new cohort, sampling or official valid/test.

previous_seven_cases.disposition: Historical exploratory evidence; not relabelled train or repeated.

previous_training_semantic_cases.disposition: Previously executed/closed event-date triplets; license creation outputs_seen=false is historical, not an unexecuted experiment.

R84.availability: Aggregate metrics/confusions and same-forward diagonal identities.
R84.limitation: Not a retained historical per-example dump; cannot infer ECQP semantic trajectories from aggregate differences.

actual_recovery_metadata.access: Read-only metadata keys/identity; no model or array computation.

selection.rule: For each represented gold class in the existing972 eval partition, select the lexicographically smallest original id_hash; freeze selection.json before model loading/forward.
selection.scope: Existing R72 group-separated eval partition of the original training prefix; not official valid/test and not a new independent population.
selection.labels_used_only_for: Stratification and post-forward audit; never model input.
selection.limits: New per-case selection rule is outcome-blind, but earlier aggregate results already informed this diagnostic. One case/class is exploratory and not representative or a confirmatory causal test.

observation.input_boundary: Existing fp16 word features cast to fp32; preserve full original batch padding in each recorded case.
observation.arrays: All available actual-forward tensors, shared h/roles/mask/features, decoder/bias; detached complete NPZ arrays with declared axes.
observation.lineage: Producer-owned ordered stages: inputs, preparation, values, measurement, prediction. Frozen encoder/training are outside this replay boundary.
observation.validation: Four exact original972 aggregate metric/confusion/CE reproductions; exact detached alpha*utilities+bias logit identity; sample-trace.v2 complete structure and first/last arbitrary-coordinate reader checks for every representation.
observation.historical_logits: No historical per-example logit dump; do not claim equality to one.
observation.semantic_boundary: Token attention or entity mass is not semantic relevance. No masking/editing/intervention or semantic-causality claim.

retention.private_outputs: selection.json, case-inputs.json, sample-trace.json, shared input NPZ, per-condition head NPZ, exact local closure marker under scientific-work/private-trace.
retention.recovery: Existing accepted inputs and checkpoints reused on the same node. Source alone does not certify their durable recovery. No new COS protection claimed.

requires: New exact BOTH implementation/lifecycle review, including tests, launch argv, private execution contract, whitelist and read-only observer.
Fresh controller/node health and whole shared queue quiescence before paired temporary binding transaction.
Single finite CPU diagnostic via shared scheduler; terminal/quiescent proof and exact binding restore.
No use of R83 review hashes for changed source; no direct SSH model execution.

primary_after_collection: Inspect paired stronger/weaker/unchanged cases and task text without declaring semantics from attention. Update recovery dossier only for observed links; generate a distinct mechanism only after evidence audit.
